## Wi-Fi Dead Zone Skill · Changelog v1.0.1

- Added new files: references, scripts
- Removed file: skill-card.md
- Updated internal file structure for better organization and reference guide access
- No changes to user-facing description, commands, or workflow

- Initial release of Wi-Fi Dead Zone Solver.
- Models home layout using rooms, walls, and materials to estimate Wi-Fi signal per room.
- Generates ASCII signal heatmaps and grid-searches 676 locations for optimal router placement.
- Provides clear advice for mesh node placement and channel assignments based on real physics.
- Includes commands for analysis, calibration with phone measurements, model vs. reality comparison, and example/demo runs.
